description: Use when you need one game's published weather call. Pass team (a code such as BUF or NE) or gameId (such as 2026-w04-ne-buf). Optional weekId; omit it for the current week. A gameId selects that game's week when weekId is omitted. Returns that game plus asOf, stale, and nextUpdate.

team.description: NFL team code, such as BUF or NE.

weekId.description: Week id YYYY-wNN, for example 2026-w04. Regular season weeks are 1–18. Omit for the current week.

name: get_game
title: One game
